mapper.delete: /* SvcReqAddressMapper.deleteBySvcReqSn */ DELETE FROM SVC_REQ_ADDRESS WHERE SVC_REQ_SN = #{svcReqSn}
mapper.insert:
/* SvcReqAddressMapper.insertAll */ INSERT INTO SVC_REQ_ADDRESS (SVC_REQ_SN, SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN, SVC_REQ_STEP_SN, ADDR_ROLE_KEY, SVC_REQ_ADDR_SEQ_NO, ADDR_FIELD_SN, DADDR_FIELD_SN, RGN_SIDO_NM, RGN_SIGUNGU_NM, SVC_REQ_ADDR_ENC, SVC_REQ_DADDR_ENC, SVC_REQ_ZIP_ENC, SVC_REQ_ADDR_PBLC_RGN_YN, SVC_REQ_ADDR_REG_ID, SVC_REQ_ADDR_UPDT_ID) VALUES
(#{a.svcReqSn}, #{a.formTemplateSn}, #{a.stepSn}, #{a.addressRoleKey}, #{a.sequence}, #{a.addressFieldSn}, #{a.detailFieldSn}, #{a.sido}, #{a.sigungu}, #{a.encryptedAddress}, #{a.encryptedDetailAddress}, #{a.encryptedZonecode}, #{a.publicRegionYn}, #{a.regId}, #{a.updtId})
mapper.select: /* SvcReqAddressMapper.findBySvcReqSn */ SELECT A.SVC_REQ_SN AS svcReqSn, A.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN AS formTemplateSn, A.SVC_REQ_STEP_SN AS stepSn, S.SVC_REQ_STEP_KEY AS stepKey, A.ADDR_ROLE_KEY AS addressRoleKey, CAST(A.SVC_REQ_ADDR_SEQ_NO AS SIGNED) AS sequence, A.ADDR_FIELD_SN AS addressFieldSn, AF.SVC_REQ_FIELD_KEY AS addressFieldKey, A.DADDR_FIELD_SN AS detailFieldSn, DF.SVC_REQ_FIELD_KEY AS detailFieldKey, A.RGN_SIDO_NM AS sido, A.RGN_SIGUNGU_NM AS sigungu, A.SVC_REQ_ADDR_ENC AS encryptedAddress, A.SVC_REQ_DADDR_ENC AS encryptedDetailAddress, A.SVC_REQ_ZIP_ENC AS encryptedZonecode, A.SVC_REQ_ADDR_PBLC_RGN_YN AS publicRegionYn FROM SVC_REQ_ADDRESS A JOIN SVC_REQ_STEP_DEF S ON S.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = A.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN AND S.SVC_REQ_STEP_SN = A.SVC_REQ_STEP_SN JOIN SVC_REQ_FIELD_DEF AF ON AF.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = A.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN AND AF.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SN = A.ADDR_FIELD_SN LEFT JOIN SVC_REQ_FIELD_DEF DF ON DF.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = A.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN AND DF.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SN = A.DADDR_FIELD_SN WHERE A.SVC_REQ_SN = #{svcReqSn} AND A.SVC_REQ_ADDR_USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY A.SVC_REQ_STEP_SN, A.ADDR_ROLE_KEY, A.SVC_REQ_ADDR_SEQ_NO
